units.source_text: 《史记·周本纪》中说：“楚有养由基，善射者也，

en.t: The Annals of Zhou in the Records of the Grand Historian says: In Chu there was Yang Youji, a man skilled in archery,

units.source_text: 去柳叶百步射之，百发而百中之。”

en.t: who could stand a hundred paces away from a willow leaf and shoot at it, hitting the mark every time, a hundred shots out of a hundred.
